# Probe-proven attribute shapes (Divi 5.15.1)

Each section below is one candidate shape that `node scripts/verify-shapes.cjs` rendered on the real Divi of the Docker dev site: two throwaway draft pages identical except for the candidate's values, opened in Chromium at 1280, 900 and 400 px. A shape counts as proven when the emitted page styles or the computed styles of the module changed at some width and the page did not overflow a phone. `php scripts/promote-shapes.php` adds the proven paths to `fixtures/shapes/verified-shapes.json` (`how: probe`).

## heading-size-per-device

Block: `heading`. Set on top of the base block:

- `title.decoration.font.font.desktop.value.size` = `"48px"`
- `title.decoration.font.font.tablet.value.size` = `"36px"`
- `title.decoration.font.font.phone.value.size` = `"24px"`

Measured (page A = base, page B = base + the values above):

| Width | Changed | Computed-style differences | Stylesheet differs | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1280 px | yes | 14 | yes | `0:div:block-size: 40px -> 58px` |
| 900 px | yes | 14 | yes | `0:div:block-size: 40px -> 46px` |
| 400 px | yes | 14 | yes | `0:div:block-size: 40px -> 34px` |

Phone overflow at 400 px: no.

Registered paths added: none (every path was already registered by a builder export, which stays the stronger evidence).

## image-aspect-ratio-4-3-cover

Block: `image`. Set on top of the base block:

- `module.advanced.sizing.desktop.value.aspectRatio` = `{"width":"4","height":"3"}`
- `image.decoration.fit.desktop.value.objectFit` = `"cover"`

Measured (page A = base, page B = base + the values above):

| Width | Changed | Computed-style differences | Stylesheet differs | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1280 px | yes | 14 | yes | `0:div:block-size: 576px -> 768px` |
| 900 px | yes | 14 | yes | `0:div:block-size: 405px -> 540px` |
| 400 px | yes | 14 | yes | `0:div:block-size: 180px -> 240px` |

Phone overflow at 400 px: no.

Note: objectFit was measured only together with aspectRatio (see docs/guide-shapes-evidence-5.14.md) and is registered as part of the pair, not proven alone.

Registered paths added:

- `image.decoration.fit.{bp}.value.objectFit`
- `module.advanced.sizing.{bp}.value.aspectRatio.height`
- `module.advanced.sizing.{bp}.value.aspectRatio.width`

## bg-gradient-three-stops

Block: `section`. Set on top of the base block:

- `module.decoration.background.desktop.value.gradient.stops` = `[{"position":"0","color":"#1e3a8a"},{"position":"50","color":"#7c3aed"},{"position":"100","color":"#db2777"}]`

Measured (page A = base, page B = base + the values above):

| Width | Changed | Computed-style differences | Stylesheet differs | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1280 px | yes | 1 | yes | `0:div:background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(43, 135, 218) 0%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 100%) -> linear-gradient(rgb(30, 58, 138) 0%, rgb(124, 58, 237) 50%, rgb(219, 39, 119) 100%)` |
| 900 px | yes | 1 | yes | `0:div:background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(43, 135, 218) 0%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 100%) -> linear-gradient(rgb(30, 58, 138) 0%, rgb(124, 58, 237) 50%, rgb(219, 39, 119) 100%)` |
| 400 px | yes | 1 | yes | `0:div:background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(43, 135, 218) 0%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 100%) -> linear-gradient(rgb(30, 58, 138) 0%, rgb(124, 58, 237) 50%, rgb(219, 39, 119) 100%)` |

Phone overflow at 400 px: no.

Note: A third stop on top of the two-stop base (the stop list is replaced as a whole; two or more stops are rendered). Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Background/Traits/ConstantsTrait.php:30-47 (gradient defaults: type, direction, directionRadial, stops, length, overlaysImage) and Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Utils/GradientUtils.php:792-852 (what is rendered).

Registered paths added: none (every path was already registered by a builder export, which stays the stronger evidence).

## bg-gradient-repeating

Block: `section`. Set on top of the base block:

- `module.decoration.background.desktop.value.gradient.repeat` = `"on"`
- `module.decoration.background.desktop.value.gradient.length` = `"25%"`

Measured (page A = base, page B = base + the values above):

| Width | Changed | Computed-style differences | Stylesheet differs | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1280 px | yes | 1 | yes | `0:div:background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(43, 135, 218) 0%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 100%) -> repeating-linear-gradient(rgb(43, 135, 218) 0%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 100%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 25%)` |
| 900 px | yes | 1 | yes | `0:div:background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(43, 135, 218) 0%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 100%) -> repeating-linear-gradient(rgb(43, 135, 218) 0%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 100%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 25%)` |
| 400 px | yes | 1 | yes | `0:div:background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(43, 135, 218) 0%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 100%) -> repeating-linear-gradient(rgb(43, 135, 218) 0%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 100%, rgb(41, 196, 169) 25%)` |

Phone overflow at 400 px: no.

Note: Repeating gradient: `repeat` on makes it repeating-*-gradient and `length` is the size of one repeat (GradientUtils.php:827-849). Pair: repeat has no visible effect unless the length is shorter than the box, so both are set together. Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Background/Traits/ConstantsTrait.php:30-47 (gradient defaults: type, direction, directionRadial, stops, length, overlaysImage) and Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Utils/GradientUtils.php:792-852 (what is rendered).

## Not taught (backgrounds)

Candidates from `backgrounds.json` that were measured and are not taught, with the reason:

- `bg-pattern-transform-rotate`: no effect (dead). Pattern transform: a list holding any of flipHorizontal, flipVertical, rotate, invert (BackgroundStyleUtils.php:165-189). Measured DEAD on polka-dots: its rotated artwork is byte-identical to its default (visual-builder/packages/mask-and-pattern-library/src/components/pattern-svg/components/polka-dots.json, regular.default == regular.rotated), so rotate changes nothing for this style; the same holds for crosses, pinwheel, shippo and tufted. Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Background/Traits/ConstantsTrait.php:71-84 (pattern defaults: enabled, style, color, transform, size, width, height, repeatOrigin, horizontalOffset, verticalOffset, repeat, blend) and Background.php:192-282 (what is rendered).
- `bg-pattern-offset-without-origin`: no effect (dead). Missing precondition: the pattern offsets with NO repeatOrigin. Background.php:266 prints background-position only when repeatOrigin is set, so this is expected to change nothing. Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Background/Traits/ConstantsTrait.php:71-84 (pattern defaults: enabled, style, color, transform, size, width, height, repeatOrigin, horizontalOffset, verticalOffset, repeat, blend) and Background.php:192-282 (what is rendered).
- `bg-pattern-offset-repeat-space`: no effect (dead). Missing precondition: the pattern offsets while repeat is space. Background.php:266 skips background-position when repeat is space, so this is expected to change nothing. Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Background/Traits/ConstantsTrait.php:71-84 (pattern defaults: enabled, style, color, transform, size, width, height, repeatOrigin, horizontalOffset, verticalOffset, repeat, blend) and Background.php:192-282 (what is rendered).
- `bg-pattern-offset-size-stretch`: no effect (dead). Missing precondition: the pattern offsets while size is stretch. Background.php:266 skips background-position when size is stretch, so this is expected to change nothing. Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Background/Traits/ConstantsTrait.php:71-84 (pattern defaults: enabled, style, color, transform, size, width, height, repeatOrigin, horizontalOffset, verticalOffset, repeat, blend) and Background.php:192-282 (what is rendered).
- `bg-image-offset-without-position`: only the emitted stylesheet changed, no computed style (not accepted without allowCssOnly and a note). Missing precondition: the image offsets with no named position. BackgroundStyleUtils.php:44-52 applies an offset only next to left/right and :57-66 only next to top/bottom; with the default centre it prints plain "center". Divi still emits that one declaration, so the probe can only call this css-only (no visible movement). Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Background/Traits/ConstantsTrait.php:48-62 (image defaults: size, width, height, position, horizontalOffset, verticalOffset, repeat, blend, parallax) and Traits/StyleDeclarationTrait.php:355-394 (what is rendered).
- `bg-mask-offset-without-position`: no effect (dead). Missing precondition: the mask offsets with no position set. Background.php:155 prints background-position only when position is set, so this is expected to change nothing. Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Background/Traits/ConstantsTrait.php:85-98 (mask defaults: enabled, style, color, transform, aspectRatio, size, width, height, position, horizontalOffset, verticalOffset, blend) and Background.php:80-166 (what is rendered).

Not measured, therefore not taught as proven (from `fixtures/shapes/not-taught-backgrounds.json`):

- Background video (video.mp4 / video.webm): excluded by policy: it needs a media file or URL, and the plugin never teaches remote or invented media
- Image blend modes other than multiply and soft-light: not rendered: the other modes in Functions.php:152-171 (screen, overlay, darken, lighten, color-dodge, color-burn, hard-light, difference, exclusion, hue, saturation, color, luminosity) were not sampled
- Pattern and mask blend modes other than multiply: not rendered: only multiply was probed for patterns and for masks
- Setting a default back explicitly: mask size stretch, mask aspectRatio landscape, pattern size initial, image repeat no-repeat: not rendered as a set value (they are the defaults); the topic names them only as defaults
- Hover and sticky states of any background setting: not measured (the probe saves one state, value)
- tablet and phone overrides for anything except the gradient direction: only bg-gradient-tablet-phone-override was probed; the other families use the same breakpoint inheritance in Divi's code but were not rendered with overrides
- A pattern and a mask, or a mask and a gradient, on the same element: combinations were not probed; every candidate changes one family at a time
- Width, height and offset units other than px and %: not rendered: Divi also allows em, rem, cm, mm, in, pc, ex, vh, vw (Functions.php:127-141), only px and % were tried
- Gradient stop colours given as global colour or variable references, and a gradient length in a unit other than %: not rendered in these candidates (global styles are taught elsewhere and need the site's own ids)
- Pattern and mask styles from add-on plugins: only the 24 pattern and 23 mask styles shipped in Divi 5.15.1 were rendered

## Not taught (dividers)

Candidates from `dividers.json` that were measured and are not taught, with the reason:

- `dv-bottom-repeat-3x-clouds`: no effect (dead). Precondition probe: repeat 3x on `clouds`, a NON-repeatable style. Dividers.php:248-266 gives it background-size cover and ignores repeat; Divi's own field hides repeat for none, clouds, clouds2 and triangle (includes/builder/module/field/Divider.php:221). Expected DEAD.
- `dv-bottom-repeat-3x-triangle`: no effect (dead). Precondition probe: repeat 3x on `triangle`, a non-repeatable style (Dividers.php:248-266; field/Divider.php:221). Expected DEAD.
- `dv-bottom-repeat-3x-clouds2`: no effect (dead). Precondition probe: repeat 3x on `clouds2`, a non-repeatable style (Dividers.php:248-266; field/Divider.php:221). Expected DEAD.
- `dv-inner-shadow-on`: no effect (dead). Expected DEAD after a first smoke run and a check of the rendered HTML (no `et_pb_inner_shadow` class and no inset shadow on the page). `module.advanced.innerShadow` on a section (module.json attrName module.advanced.innerShadow, a toggle; default render attribute is "off": section/module-default-render-attributes.json:5-8). Divi's includes/builder/feature/dynamic-assets/assets/css/section.css defines `.et_pb_inner_shadow{box-shadow:inset 0 0 7px rgba(0,0,0,.07)}`.
- `dv-row-gutter-flex`: no effect (dead). Precondition probe: row gutter width 4 on the DEFAULT flex layout. RowModule.php:104 adds the et_pb_gutters class only when the layout is not flex, and layout_style_declaration (RowModule.php:449-475) writes only for display block. Expected DEAD.

Not measured, therefore not taught as proven (from `fixtures/shapes/not-taught-dividers.json`):

- Inner shadow (`module.advanced.innerShadow`): dead: the candidate `dv-inner-shadow-on` changed nothing at any width. The 5.15.1 front-end render emits no `et_pb_inner_shadow` class and no inset shadow for it (checked in the rendered HTML), although the builder lists the toggle (section/module.json attrName module.advanced.innerShadow) and Divi's section.css still defines `.et_pb_inner_shadow`. The topic says so and never teaches it
- Dividers on a row or a column: not offered: in module-library/src/components the section module.json carries `module.advanced.dividers`; the row and column module.json files do not (source). Never probed on a row or column
- Divider `fullwidth` (section type fullwidth) and the `fullwidth` key: not rendered: Dividers.php:277-281 gives a fullwidth section a z-index of 10 like `arrangement: above`; it comes from the section's type, not from a divider setting. Only `arrangement` was probed
- What `arrangement: above` does to overlapping content: only the z-index change (1 to 10) was measured; that rows and modules hide behind an `above` divider is Divi's own description (includes/builder/module/field/Divider.php:247-260), marked (source)
- Height units other than px and %, heights outside the probed ones, and the 0-500 range: not rendered: only 100px (default), 200px, 50px and 30px and 50% were probed. The range 0-500 and the units em rem cm mm in pt pc ex vh vw are Divi's own field definition (field/Divider.php:189-206); the unit list is not taught
- Repeat values other than 3x, and repeat 1x: only 3x was rendered (1x is the default). The field range 1-20 is Divi's own (field/Divider.php:208-224), marked (source)
- Divider colour as rgba, a global colour reference or a gradient: not rendered: only a hex colour was probed. DividersStyle.php:137-147 resolves a global colour to a value (source); a sibling whose background is a gradient or image does not give its colour (DividersStyleUtils.php:143 reads only the sibling's `color`)
- The black fallback when the neighbour and the section share a colour: source only (Dividers.php:180-182): with no divider `color`, the same colour on both sections and no image/gradient/pattern/mask, Divi paints the divider black. Not rendered as a separate case
- Hover and sticky states of a divider, tablet/phone overrides other than height and style: not measured: the probe saves one state (value). Tablet and phone `height` and phone `style` were measured; tablet/phone `color`, `repeat`, `flip` and `arrangement` inherit in Divi's code (DividersStyle.php:183-220) but were not rendered with overrides
- Divider between a page section and a Theme Builder header or footer, or a section inside a Theme Builder body: not measured: the probe renders ordinary sections in the page content
- Add-on divider styles (the `divi_divider_library_divider` filter): excluded: only the 26 styles Divi ships (DividerSvg.php:50-77) were probed; a style an add-on registers is not taught
- Row gutter widths 2 and 3, `makeEqual`, `alignColumns`, tablet/phone gutter overrides, and the section gutter of a specialty section: not rendered: only width 4 and width 1 on a display block row were probed (and width 4 on the default flex row, which is dead). The section gutter acts only on a specialty section (SectionModule.php:176-189); no specialty section was rendered

## Not taught (motion)

Candidates from `motion.json` that were measured and are not taught, with the reason:

- `mo-tr-needs-a-state`: no effect (dead). PRECONDITION: the same duration on a group with NO hover state (only a plain background). Source says no transition properties are emitted without a state, so this is expected to be DEAD. Transition properties exist only for a state the module has (hover here): Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Transition/TransitionTraits/StyleDeclarationTrait.php:68 get_transition_properties, empty list returns '' at :100-102; defaults duration 300ms (:69), delay 0ms (:70), speedCurve names easeInOut/ease/easeIn/easeOut/linear mapped to the CSS timing functions at :80-98 (anything else falls back to ease).
- `mo-hv-button-shadow`: no effect (dead). Button box shadow preset3 on hover (button.json lists boxShadow under the button element). A hover value sits next to the normal one under the key `hover` instead of `value` (the registry's export-proven hover paths use the same layout). Measured with the pointer on the element, the control page hovered identically.
- `mo-hv-button-scale`: no effect (dead). Button transform scale 108% on hover (button.json lists transform under the button element). A hover value sits next to the normal one under the key `hover` instead of `value` (the registry's export-proven hover paths use the same layout). Measured with the pointer on the element, the control page hovered identically.
- `mo-an-dir-fade-needs-no-direction`: no effect (dead). PRECONDITION: a direction on style fade. The options for fade have no direction (Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/Module/Options/Animation/AnimationUtils.php:241-250), so this is expected to be DEAD. Entrance animation is read by Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/Module/Options/Animation/AnimationUtils.php: is_enabled (:571) needs a desktop style other than none; options per style at :239-284; presets and defaults at :316-503 (duration 1000ms, delay 0ms, intensity 50%, starting opacity 0%, speed curve ease-in-out, repeat once, direction center). Divi writes the result into the element on load (classes `et_animated <style>`, inline animation-duration/delay/opacity/timing-function) and removes them when the animation ends. Probe technique: the control and the candidate carry a 5000ms delay (set last wins), so at the moment of measuring the element still waits at its first frame and two loads agree; the compared attributes are the element's class and style.
- `mo-an-intensity-fade-fixed`: no effect (dead). PRECONDITION: an intensity (slide) on style fade. Source: fade and bounce ignore intensity (Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/Module/Options/Animation/AnimationUtils.php:421-424), so this is expected to be DEAD. Entrance animation is read by Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/Module/Options/Animation/AnimationUtils.php: is_enabled (:571) needs a desktop style other than none; options per style at :239-284; presets and defaults at :316-503 (duration 1000ms, delay 0ms, intensity 50%, starting opacity 0%, speed curve ease-in-out, repeat once, direction center). Divi writes the result into the element on load (classes `et_animated <style>`, inline animation-duration/delay/opacity/timing-function) and removes them when the animation ends. Probe technique: the control and the candidate carry a 5000ms delay (set last wins), so at the moment of measuring the element still waits at its first frame and two loads agree; the compared attributes are the element's class and style.
- `mo-an-phone-style-none`: no effect (dead). A phone override of the style to none over a desktop fade: should change 400 px only. Entrance animation is read by Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/Module/Options/Animation/AnimationUtils.php: is_enabled (:571) needs a desktop style other than none; options per style at :239-284; presets and defaults at :316-503 (duration 1000ms, delay 0ms, intensity 50%, starting opacity 0%, speed curve ease-in-out, repeat once, direction center). Divi writes the result into the element on load (classes `et_animated <style>`, inline animation-duration/delay/opacity/timing-function) and removes them when the animation ends. Probe technique: the control and the candidate carry a 5000ms delay (set last wins), so at the moment of measuring the element still waits at its first frame and two loads agree; the compared attributes are the element's class and style.
- `mo-sc-offset-needs-enable`: no effect (dead). PRECONDITION: an offset without the effect switched on. Expected DEAD. Scroll effects are applied by Divi's script on scroll: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/Module/Options/Scroll/ScrollEffectsUtils.php:37-124 defaults (each effect has enable, viewport top/start/end/bottom, offset start/mid/end; motionTriggerStart middle), resolver map :136-141 (blur=blur, fade=opacity, rotating=rotate, scaling=scale, horizontalMotion=translateX, verticalMotion=translateY). Measured by scrolling the section's centre to a fixed viewport position (the control page is scrolled identically) and comparing computed styles and the bounding rectangle.
- `mo-st-offset-needs-position`: no effect (dead). PRECONDITION: a top offset without a sticky position. Expected DEAD. Sticky is applied by Divi's script on scroll: valid positions top, bottom, topBottom (Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/Module/Options/Sticky/StickyUtils.php:507-515); offsets and limits are separate settings (Sticky.php field: top offset hidden for position bottom :138, bottom offset hidden for top :157). Measured by scrolling so that the section's natural place is off screen (scrollAt -0.5: above) or below it (1.5) and comparing computed position and the bounding rectangle with the control scrolled identically.

Not measured, therefore not taught as proven (from `fixtures/shapes/not-taught-motion.json`):

- Interactions (`module.decoration.interactions`: click, hover or scroll triggers that start an effect on another element): not built, so not taught. Divi 5.15.1 reads the saved list in includes/builder-5/server/Packages/Module/Options/Interactions/InteractionsScriptData.php:128-160 (each entry needs an id, a triggerClass, a trigger, an effect and a target class, which the builder generates), but the lists of valid triggers and effects live only in the builder's JavaScript, no real export of an interaction is held, and a hand-written entry could not be checked against a source or an export. Never probed
- Hover on a row, column, section, image, blurb or any module other than the group, heading and button measured here: not rendered: hover was measured on `divi/group` (module-level background, border, box shadow, transform, filters), on `divi/heading` (title text colour) and on `divi/button` (button background, text and border colour, plus the module-level box shadow and scale). Other hosts use the same option groups (module.json lists them) but were not rendered
- Hover box shadow and hover transform set through the button ELEMENT paths (`button.decoration.boxShadow`, `button.decoration.transform`): dead: candidates mo-hv-button-shadow and mo-hv-button-scale changed nothing at any width although the button's module.json lists those groups under `button`. The module-level paths (`module.decoration.boxShadow`, `module.decoration.transform`) rendered and are the ones taught
- Hover states at tablet and phone, and the hover of any setting not listed in the topic (spacing hover, font size or weight hover, text shadow, icon, gradient or image background hover, filters other than brightness and saturate, box shadow `spread`/`horizontal`/`position` on their own, transform skew and origin on hover): not rendered: the probe measured the desktop hover state only. Touch screens have no hover, so a hover-only effect is not a phone design
- Transition on the sticky state, `advancedProperties`, and transition settings other than duration, delay and speedCurve: not rendered: TransitionTraits/StyleDeclarationTrait.php:56 reads `advancedProperties` and the sticky state, but only the hover state was probed
- Entrance animation: elements below the fold, and the moment it starts: not watched: the animated element was at the top of the page. Divi starts the animation when the element comes into view (source: AnimationUtils.php generate_data; the script lives in the builder bundle script-library-animation.js); that was not measured
- Entrance animation on a phone switched off through a phone `style` of none: dead: candidate mo-an-phone-style-none changed nothing at 400 px. Divi decides whether an element animates from the DESKTOP style (AnimationUtils.php:571-574); the topic does not teach a per-device off switch
- Entrance animation `direction` on fade, `intensity` on fade and bounce: dead, as the source says: fade has no direction and fade and bounce have a fixed intensity (AnimationUtils.php:241-262, 421-424); candidates mo-an-dir-fade-needs-no-direction and mo-an-intensity-fade-fixed measured nothing
- How an entrance animation LOOKS, its smoothness, and the order of several animated elements: never claimed. The probe holds the element at its first frame (a long delay in the control and the candidate) and compares the classes, the inline animation settings and the computed styles; it did not watch a motion play
- Animation values outside the probed ones: durations and delays other than 1000/2000/3000/4000/5000/8000ms, intensity percentages other than 20%, starting opacity other than 40%: not rendered: one non-default value per setting was measured. The defaults are Divi's own (AnimationUtils.php:383-385, 440-443, 473)
- Scroll effects: `viewport` and `offset` on the effects other than the ones measured, `motionTriggerStart` bottom, and units: not rendered: only the vertical-motion offset start/end, the vertical-motion viewport top, the trigger `top` and the fade offset start were measured, with one value each. The defaults are Divi's own (ScrollEffectsUtils.php:37-124)
- Grid motion (`gridMotion`): not offered: it is commented out in the preset map (ScrollPresetAttrsMap.php:35-39) and acts on child modules of a parent with `gridMotion.enable`; never probed
- Scroll effects on a row, column or module, and the tablet override of a scroll effect: not rendered: every scroll candidate was a `divi/section`. Only a phone override (`enable: off` on phones) was measured
- Sticky on a row, column or module; `limit.top`, `limit.bottom`, `offset.surrounding` and `transition`: not rendered: every sticky candidate was a `divi/section` (the probe's neighbour sections exist only for sections). The limit values (none, body, section, row, column) and the toggles are Divi's own field definition (includes/builder/module/field/Sticky.php:164-210, 244-269) and are not taught. The default guide's sticky text is left as it is
- Sticky or scroll effects inside a Theme Builder header or footer: not measured: the probe renders ordinary sections in the page content
- Respecting a visitor's reduced-motion setting: no claim: the 5.15.1 theme files (CSS, JavaScript and PHP, including the animation, scroll-effect and sticky code) were searched for `prefers-reduced-motion` and the only hits are the builder's AI app, onboarding and a WordPress library, not Divi's animation, scroll or sticky code. The plugin cannot add CSS, so the topic only advises keeping motion gentle
- Motion from add-on plugins and the `divi_module_options_animation_data` filter: excluded: only what Divi ships was probed

## Not taught (layout)

Candidates from `layout.json` that were measured and are not taught, with the reason:

- `lay-pos-mode-relative`: only the emitted stylesheet changed, no computed style (not accepted without allowCssOnly and a note). position.mode "relative" alone. Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Position/Position.php:114 (valid modes relative, absolute, fixed), Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Position/Position.php:136-164 (relative) and :167-194 (absolute and fixed: top/left 0px unless an origin and offsets say otherwise). Placed in a column on a purple 160px x 80px group ("decor"), followed by a light grey 200px-tall group ("card") in the same column; the probe records where the decor sits and how much it overlaps the card. Measured: css-only (the stylesheet changed, no computed style, the rectangle did not move): modules are already position relative on the page.
- `lay-pos-mode-default`: no effect (dead). position.mode "default" is not one of the valid modes (Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Position/Position.php:114, :122): precondition probe, expected to do nothing. Placed in a column on a purple 160px x 80px group ("decor"), followed by a light grey 200px-tall group ("card") in the same column; the probe records where the decor sits and how much it overlaps the card.
- `lay-pos-origin-needs-mode`: only the emitted stylesheet changed, no computed style (not accepted without allowCssOnly and a note). An origin without a mode: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Position/Position.php:107-123 reads origin[mode], so an origin for absolute does nothing for a module that is not absolute. Precondition probe. Placed in a column on a purple 160px x 80px group ("decor"), followed by a light grey 200px-tall group ("card") in the same column; the probe records where the decor sits and how much it overlaps the card. Measured: css-only (the stylesheet changed, no computed style): the origin is read for the module's own mode.
- `lay-pos-origin-top-left`: no effect (dead). position.origin.absolute "top left" on an absolute decor (mode set in the base). Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Position/Position.php:123-126 (the first word is the vertical side, the second the horizontal side; the default is "top left"), :167-194 (the named sides get the offsets, a "center" side gets 50% and the transform translate of Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Transform/TransformTraits/StyleDeclarationTrait.php:120-128). Placed in a column on a purple 160px x 80px group ("decor"), followed by a light grey 200px-tall group ("card") in the same column; the probe records where the decor sits and how much it overlaps the card. "top left" is the default, so this is expected to do nothing.
- `lay-pos-rel-origin-needs-relative-mode`: no effect (dead). origin.absolute on a decor whose mode is relative: Source Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Position/Position.php:123 reads origin[mode], so origin.absolute is ignored when the mode is relative. Precondition probe. Placed in a column on a purple 160px x 80px group ("decor"), followed by a light grey 200px-tall group ("card") in the same column; the probe records where the decor sits and how much it overlaps the card.
- `lay-pos-abs-outside-right`: overflows a phone at 400 px (the page is 20 px wider than the screen). An absolute decor hanging 60px outside the right edge of its column (mode absolute, origin.absolute "top right", offset.horizontal "-60px": a declared triple). The phone overflow check decides whether this is safe. Placed in a column on a purple 160px x 80px group ("decor"), followed by a light grey 200px-tall group ("card") in the same column; the probe records where the decor sits and how much it overlaps the card. Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Position/Position.php:167-194.
- `lay-order-direct-value`: no effect (dead). order written directly as the value (value: 1) instead of value.order: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Order/Order.php:55 reads $attr_value["order"], so a bare number should do nothing. Shape probe. Placed in a row of two half-width columns (the row and columns use the shapes Divi writes for two equal columns that stack on a phone); the probe records where the candidate column sits.
- `lay-dis-wrong-value`: no effect (dead). disabledOn given a value other than "on" ("true"). Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/DisabledOn/DisabledOn.php:56 compares with "on" exactly. Shape probe. Source: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/DisabledOn/DisabledOn.php:56-62 (the value "on" writes display: none !important), Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/Module/Options/DisabledOn/DisabledOnStyle.php (one rule per breakpoint, each limited to that breakpoint's own width range: phone up to 767px, tablet up to 980px, see Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Framework/Breakpoint/Breakpoint.php). - `lay-spc-sync-only`: no effect (dead). padding.syncVertical "on" with no side value: Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Spacing/Spacing.php:112-123 has no sync logic, only the four side values are written. Precondition probe.

Not measured, therefore not taught as proven (from `fixtures/shapes/not-taught-layout.json`):

- Position on a row, column or section, and absolute or fixed positioning of anything but the group, image, heading, text, button and blurb measured here: not rendered: every position candidate was a module placed in a column. Row, column and section also list `position` in their module.json but were not probed, and an absolute section or row would leave the page flow
- Position values other than the ones measured: `origin.relative` other than "bottom left", `origin.fixed` other than "bottom right", tablet and phone overrides other than the phone mode and the tablet vertical offset, position in a hover or sticky state: not rendered: one value each. The rule for the origin words is read from Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Position/Position.php:123-126 (the first word is the vertical side, the second the horizontal side)
- The size and overlap of an absolute image module (candidate lay-pos-host-image): not relied on: the image module's rectangle was 1024 x 16 px in this candidate's pages and 1024 x 576 px in the sizing candidates (the image had not been laid out when it was measured), so only its computed position change is claimed, not an overlap area
- Stacking against a sticky or fixed header, a Theme Builder header or footer, a section with `sticky`, and a z-index above 5 or below -1: not measured: the probe renders ordinary page content with the admin bar of the preview on top. Only 5, "5", -1 and 2 were set
- Overlap amounts for other sizes and for the gap Divi leaves between modules: not generalised: the overlap areas were measured for the 160px x 80px decor and the 200px card of the candidates; a different size overlaps by a different amount
- Whether an overlap is readable: text over a picture or a coloured block: never claimed. The probe measures rectangles and which element is on top at the centre of the overlap; it does not check contrast or legibility
- `disabledOn` on tabletWide, phoneWide and the widescreen breakpoints, and any width other than 1280, 900 and 400 px: not measured: Divi lists phone up to 767px, phoneWide up to 860px, tablet up to 980px and tabletWide up to 1024px (Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Framework/Breakpoint/Breakpoint.php:76-110, source); the topic states only the three widths that were rendered
- `disabledOn` visibility mode "transparent" (half-transparent instead of hidden): not offered as an attribute: DisabledOn.php:57-58 reads it from a parameter the module passes, not from the saved layout, so no layout path was built and nothing was probed
- Hidden content, accessibility and search: never claimed: a module hidden with display none is still in the page's HTML; how a search engine or a screen reader treats it was not measured
- `order` on rows, sections and other hosts, `order` inside grid containers, and order values other than -1, 1 and 0: not rendered: order was measured on two half-width columns of one row and on a heading inside a column
- Sizing on rows and sections (`innerSizing`, row `sizing.items`), `module.advanced.sizing` on modules other than the image, and `size` with the value `custom` (flexGrow and flexShrink numbers): not rendered: group, column and image were measured. The custom flex numbers are read in Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Sizing/Sizing.php:151-161 (source) and were not probed
- Flex item `alignSelf` values other than flex-end, and grid item settings other than `gridColumnSpan` (gridRowSpan, gridColumnStart, gridColumnEnd, gridRowStart, gridRowEnd, gridAlignSelf, gridJustifySelf): not rendered: one value each. They are read in Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Sizing/Sizing.php:180-188 and :256-298 (source)
- `flexType` values other than 4_24, 10_24, 16_24, 18_24 and 20_24 (and the default guide's 24_24, 12_24, 8_24, 6_24), and rows with three or more columns: not rendered: only two-column rows were measured, the candidate column against its complement (24 minus N)
- Flex and grid layout on a row, column, section or module: not rendered: every layout candidate was a group holding three or six headings. Row, column, section and the text-like modules list `layout` in their module.json
- Grid options: gridColumnWidths "equalFixed", "auto" and "manual" (gridColumnWidth, gridTemplateColumns), gridRowHeights and its row settings, gridAutoFlow, gridDensity, gridAutoColumns and gridAutoRows, collapseEmptyColumns, gridJustifyItems and gridOffsetRules: not rendered: read in Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Layout/Layout.php:110-254 (source). Measured: display grid, gridColumnCount (desktop, tablet, phone), gap, gridColumnWidths "equalMinimum" with gridColumnMinWidth, alignItems
- Overflow clipping as a picture: whether content is visibly cut, a scroll bar appears, or a sticky child stops working inside an overflow container: never claimed: the probe compares computed `overflow` values (and the page width). Setting one axis changed the other computed axis too (a CSS rule), which the topic records
- Spacing units and flags beyond the ones measured: calc(), vw outside the one clamp(), margin sync flags and `padding.syncHorizontal`: not rendered. Measured: px, a 5% padding and clamp(48px, 8vw, 120px) (top and bottom padding of a section). A spacing value with a semicolon, backslash or brace is refused by the plugin's own gate (CUSTOM_CSS_NOT_ALLOWED) before it could be probed, and Divi drops it as well (Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/StyleLibrary/Declarations/Spacing/Spacing.php:143-154, source)
- Flex settings on a row: `layout.flexWrap` on a row appears only as the base of the column-width and order candidates: not measured on its own: the row shape is the one Divi writes for equal columns that stack on a phone (nowrap on desktop, wrap on phones); the candidates change the columns, not the row
- A two-column row as the positioned ancestor: not measured: every position candidate sat in a one-column row, so a decor anchored to a column corner depends on the column being the positioned ancestor
- z-index -1 behind a coloured row, a coloured image or a card inside a coloured section: not measured: -1 was measured behind a card in a section with no background colour, and with no card in a section and in a column with a dark background colour (the decor stayed on top at its own centre)
- Transform on hosts other than the group and the image; `translate.linked`; 3D rotation with a perspective; transform in a hover or sticky state; transform on the tablet: not rendered or covered elsewhere: hover transforms and a resting scale/skew.x are in the topic `hover-states`. Measured here: translate x/y, rotate x/y/z, skew.y, scale x and y together, origin x/y and a phone reset
- The Visual Builder: not checked: every result is a front-end render of a draft page preview on the Docker dev site (Divi 5.15.1, Chromium at 1280, 900 and 400 px)
